newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola strong buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola strong buy repeated.

text.p: Gruntal & Co analyst Mona Eraiba said Friday she repeated her strong buy rating on technology giant Motorola Inc.
-- "I'm still bullish on the stock," Eraiba said, but added that some profit-taking had been expected at current levels for the stock. "I would buy on weakness."
-- Motorola shares were off three at 86 on Friday.
-- After attending Motorola's analyst meeting on Thursday, Eraiba said she was impressed with the company's revamping of its handset business with new products.
-- Motorola said late Thursday it sees 400 million wireless telephone users worldwide by the year 2000, compared to 160 million in June 1997.

-- Motorola said the industry remains extremely competitive as wireless networks are upgraded to digital from analog, and phone prices continue to fall. But Motorola's Cellular Subscriber Sector remains solidly profitable, company officials said Thursday.
-- Motorola also said it has various new digital phones currently in field trials and ready for release.
-- The company was late to market with Global System for Mobile communications (GSM) phones, but has since launched several new products and its market share is growing.
